files.contract: Plugin entry. Imports FDO_SDK, FDOInterface, PluginMetadata, DOM, defineRenderOnLoadActions from @anikitenko/fdo-sdk and render, renderOnLoad, ACTIONS from ./render.tsx. Exports default class WebToolsWorkbenchPlugin extending FDO_SDK and implementing FDOInterface. Metadata: name Web Tools Workbench, version 1.0.0, author FDO SDK Team, description Local deterministic webmaster tools dashboard, icon exactly "applications". Declare no capabilities (declareCapabilities returns empty array). init() logs and registers NO backend handlers (all logic is browser-local UI, no window.createBackendReq needed for this plugin - all interactions are local DOM state). render() delegates to render(). renderOnLoad() delegates to renderOnLoad(). Instantiate class at end. No BasePlugin/FDOPlugin.

UI + action module. Imports css from ./styles.css and DOM, defineRenderOnLoadActions from @anikitenko/fdo-sdk. Exports render(): builds one DOM instance (const dom = new DOM()), composes full workbench markup with dom.createElement(...) and dom.renderHTML(...). Renders all seven style-map classes explicitly via dom.createClassFromStyle(css.shell), css.dashboard, css.card, css.library, css.workspace, css.result, css.dock. Structure: outer .shell[data-role=tool-workbench] containing header (data-role=tool-brand wordmark + top-right buttons data-role=tool-library-button and data-role=tool-space-button, all type=button), dashboard section data-role=tool-dashboard (data-state=open) with title "Workbench" + subtitle, a quick-access card grid containing data-role=tool-card-json (JSON Formatter quick access) and the five category tiles data-role=tool-card-text, tool-card-data, tool-card-seo, tool-card-images, tool-card-social, each a type=button with its category key; five category workspaces data-role=tool-category-workspace data-tool-category=text|data|seo|images|social each containing data-role=tool-category-input (textarea), a labelled native select where required (text: upper/lower/title; data: json/encode/decode; social: name=title/description/url inputs plus first textarea accepting fallback JSON), data-role=tool-category-result data-state=idle, type=button data-role=tool-category-action and tool-category-back. JSON workspace data-role=tool-workspace data-state=closed with type=button data-role=tool-back-dashboard, data-role=tool-json-input (textarea), a pure-form pure-form-stacked form wrapping it, type=button pure-button pure-button-primary data-role=tool-format-json, and data-role=tool-json-result data-state=idle. Library overlay data-role=tool-library data-state=closed with data-role=tool-search (input), category filter chips, quick-access row type=button data-role=tool-open-json, and type=button data-role=tool-library-close. Personal space sheet data-role=tool-space-dialog data-state=closed with type=button data-role=tool-space-close, simple tabs/sections, saved/favourite rows, and a short local-only privacy note. A .dock footer data-role=tool-dock with a back/open instrument row. Export ACTIONS object with full handler function expressions (each ({document, element}) => {...}) and a bindings list using selector + event + handler string references for every button: tool-library-button, tool-space-button, tool-card-json, tool-library-close, tool-open-json, tool-back-dashboard, tool-format-json, all five tool-card-*, all five tool-category-action, all five tool-category-back, tool-space-close. Export renderOnLoad(): returns defineRenderOnLoadActions({handlers: ACTIONS, bindings: BINDINGS, strict: true, language: 'javascript'}). All state toggling, JSON parse/stringify (2-space), text case transforms + counts, URL encode/decode, HTML analyze (title/description/headings/links/img-alt), data-URL/SVG inspect (type/dimensions/size), and social preview are implemented inside handler source strings using only document DOM APIs; valid results set data-state=success, malformed set data-state=error with a message. Closed workspaces/overlays hidden via data-state + CSS, no visible controls below active state.

Flat component stylesheet. Must literally contain: .shell { background: <forest-navy/deep-teal>; min-height: 100vh; ... } with exactly ONE simple nested rule .shell { & button { ... } }. .dashboard uses display:grid with grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr (two desktop columns). .card compact folder tile with distinct muted pastel variants (.card-text, .card-data, .card-seo, .card-images, .card-social) each a separate flat rule. .library light overlay (position:fixed, z-index above dashboard, ivory surface). .workspace ivory JSON surface. .result with data-state ready/success/error styling as separate flat selectors. .dock position:sticky (or fixed) with border. Category workspaces share .workspace base with per-category accent via separate rules. Library/space overlay z-index and backdrop; personal-space rounded sheet with dimmed background. Mobile rule: @media (max-width: 640px) { .dashboard { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } as its own simple selector. Include @keyframes for a subtle fade/slide and a separate @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule setting animation: none. No :not(), no comma-separated nested selectors, no quoted attribute values in CSS, no generated interpolation. Use Pure CSS (pure-form, pure-button, pure-button-primary) as foundation; plugin-local CSS for identity, spacing scale, type hierarchy, surfaces, focus outlines, and readable contrast. Closed states (data-state closed) hide content via display:none.

node:test + node:assert/strict tests, no npm install/host files. Import render, ACTIONS from ./render.tsx. Test 1: render() returns an HTML string whose dashboard contains the title text, data-role=tool-workbench, and every required data-role target (tool-brand, tool-dashboard, tool-library-button, tool-space-button, tool-card-json, tool-card-text, tool-card-data, tool-card-seo, tool-card-images, tool-card-social, tool-library, tool-search, tool-open-json, tool-library-close, tool-workspace, tool-back-dashboard, tool-json-input, tool-format-json, tool-json-result, tool-space-dialog, tool-space-close, and all five tool-category-workspace/input/action/result/back). Test 2: formatter markup - assert tool-json-input, tool-format-json, tool-json-result present and form uses pure-form pure-form-stacked + pure-button pure-button-primary. Test 3: every category role present with correct data-tool-category values and the two selects (text: upper/lower/title; data: json/encode/decode) and social name=title/description/url inputs. Test 4: deterministic tools - exercise the same pure functions if exported, else verify ACTIONS contains handlers for every action role; assert each tool-category-action and card binding exists in ACTIONS keys. If testing generated source, use String(renderOnLoad().source || "") only - never pass the renderOnLoad() object to assert.match. Keep at least two node:test cases; all must pass offline.
